style="shape=note;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;size=16;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=10;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#000000;" value="Notation: rounded box = process (number in the top strip); open-ended box = data store; shadowed box = external entity, drawn outside the system boundary.<br>Duplication note: Customer and D3 are each drawn twice on this diagram purely to reduce crossing connectors &#8212; both Customer boxes represent the same single external entity, and both D3 boxes represent the same single data store; the symbols keep their canonical labels (no suffix) because they are not distinct entities/stores.<br>Process 4.4 transaction guarantees: reserved inventory/movement is committed exactly once, the order and its invoice are created exactly once, and exactly one shipment is started.<br>Delivery simulation (4.5.1) is an internal component of process 4.5, not an external entity. div.div:
Notation: rounded box = process (number in the top strip); open-ended box = data store; shadowed box = external entity, drawn outside the system boundary.
Duplication note: Customer and D3 are each drawn twice on this diagram purely to reduce crossing connectors — both Customer boxes represent the same single external entity, and both D3 boxes represent the same single data store; the symbols keep their canonical labels (no suffix) because they are not distinct entities/stores.
Process 4.4 transaction guarantees: reserved inventory/movement is committed exactly once, the order and its invoice are created exactly once, and exactly one shipment is started.
Delivery simulation (4.5.1) is an internal component of process 4.5, not an external entity. Every data flow is one-directional and named.
